name: MyHotelMatch S.A.
summary: MyHotelMatch S.A. develops and operates an online platform for booking hotels, which is driven by Artificial Intelligence (AI). This company functions as an online travel agency (OTA), applying a unique model inspired by online dating. Its platform efficiently pairs travelers with hotel accommodations that best align with their respective profiles and requirements. MyHotelMatch S.A. is situated in Biot, France.
